biofilmTypes.name: Listeria monocytogenes Scott A Biofilm (Cellulose & Extracellular DNA Matrix, Food Contact SS)
biofilmTypes.matrixComponents: Extracellular Polymeric Substances (EPS), Cellulose, eDNA, Teichoic Acids
biofilmTypes.description: Virulent chilled foodborne pathogen that forms resilient cross-linked cellulose and eDNA matrices on stainless steel surfaces, responsible for persistent contamination in ready-to-eat dairy, deli meat, and seafood processing lines.

biofilmTypes.name: Pseudomonas fluorescens / aeruginosa Biofilm (Hydrated Alginate Slime & Amyloid Fibrils)
biofilmTypes.matrixComponents: Hyper-Hydrated Alginate Polysaccharide Hydrogel, Psl/Pel Exopolysaccharides
biofilmTypes.heatResistance: High EPS hydrogel buffering against chemical sanitizers
biofilmTypes.description: Psychrotrophic biofilm producer that secretes dense, slimy alginate hydrogels inside cold milk and beverage lines, shielding embedded bacteria from quaternary ammonium sanitizers and standard turbulent CIP.

biofilmTypes.name: Bacillus cereus Dairy Milkstone Biofilm (Mineralized Calcium Phosphate & Hydrophobic Spore Cluster)
biofilmTypes.matrixComponents: Mineralized Calcium Phosphate (Milkstone), Denatured Whey Proteins, Hydrophobic Appendages
biofilmTypes.heatResistance: Extreme (Survives 85°C caustic wash without physical cavitation)
biofilmTypes.description: Composite inorganic-organic bio-encrustation anchoring heat-resistant bacterial endospores into surface micro-crevices. Requires transient acoustic cavitation collapse to mechanically shatter the mineralized calcium matrix.

biofilmTypes.name: Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium (Curli Fimbriae & Cellulose Micro-Colonies)
biofilmTypes.matrixComponents: Rigid Protein Curli Amyloid Fibrils, Intertwined β-1,4-Glucan Cellulose Network
biofilmTypes.description: Robust amyloid-reinforced biofilm anchored to welded pipe joints and gasket interfaces. Micro-jetting cavitation forces exceeding 500 Pa are required to sever the tenacious curli amyloid anchor filaments.

pipeSubstrates.name: 316L Electropolished Sanitary Tubing (Ra < 0.38 µm / 15 µin, Passivated Cr2O3 Film)

pipeSubstrates.name: 304 Mill-Finish Stainless Steel (Ra ~ 0.8 µm / 32 µin, Standard Food Grade)

pipeSubstrates.name: Titanium Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) Flow Cell (High Acoustic Q-Factor & Cavitation Hardened)

pipeSubstrates.name: Chloride-Pitted / Degraded 304 SS (Ra > 1.8 µm, Micro-Cavities & Biofilm Harbors)
pipeSubstrates.cleanabilityRating: NON-COMPLIANT (Severe Microbial Retention in Pits / ASTM G32 Failure)
